summary: IM Cannabis Corp. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that director Einat Zakariya resigned from the board and all committees effective September 27, 2026, for personal reasons, with no disagreement cited regarding operations, policies or practices. The accompanying press release, dated September 28, 2026, is otherwise a corporate update restating the previously announced August 17, 2026 agreement to sell I.M.C. Holdings Ltd., after which Israeli medical cannabis operations are retained while German Adjupharm GmbH operations pass indirectly to the purchaser. No terms, advisors or board recommendation were provided. Watch for subsequent board reconstitution and sale-closing milestones.
